description: Free meeting slots finder — Find times when everyone is free. busy=name=start/end,start/end;name2=start/end (ISO local times read in timezone=, end may be just HH:MM, a bare YYYY-MM-DD blocks the whole day, name= with nothing after it = fully free), start= and end= (dates or datetimes, end date inclusive). Optional: timezone (IANA, default UTC), duration minutes (default 30), step (default 15), buffer minutes around busy blocks, work_hours=09:00-17:00 or any, weekdays=mon-fri|all|mon,wed, exclude=dates, us_holidays=true|false (default on for UTC and US zones), required=names who must attend (others become optional and slots are ranked by how many optional people are free), max_results. Returns verdict SLOTS_FOUND or NO_COMMON_SLOT, earliest slot, ranked slots in local time and UTC, merged free windows, per-day work/busy/free minutes, and least-conflict slots when nothing fits. Offline, DST-aware. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_free_slots
